in_sanskrit.name: पहल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The root word 'पह' (pah) in Sanskrit means 'before, prior to'. When suffixed with the letter 'ल' (l), it forms the word 'पहल' (pahal), which means 'first' or 'beginning'. This word is often used in Indian languages to refer to the initial or primary stage of something.
